title: invoice-credits-reconciliation-checklist-aug-2026
content:
PURPOSE: quick ad-hoc tracker for rolling up outstanding customer invoice credits and internal adjustments that need cross-team signoff (finance, sales, CS, eng). Intended as a lightweight sheet for the week-of-handback.

COLUMN HEADERS:
Invoice ID | Customer | Billing Project | Credit Amount (USD) | Credit Type | Initiated By | Owner (team/person) | Status | Target Completion | Notes / Action Items | Linked Ticket

ROWS:
INV-2026-00981 | NovaRetail Inc. | corp-hosted | 3,250.00 | Overcharge (double billing) | Sales (S-77) | Zoe Martinez (sales) | In review | 2026-08-18 | Sales sent pre-approval; finance to confirm GL code; verify on staging invoice template (ENG-12345) | JIRA-INV-4892
INV-2026-01004 | StatelyHealth | enterprise-dedicated | 1,200.00 | Promo credit applied late | CS (C-22) | Priya Kapoor (finance) | Ready for posting | 2026-08-16 | Need CS confirmation of promo code eligibility; PR #321 has partial details | https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/321
INV-2026-01011 | EduLens Labs | hosted-api | 450.00 | Manual refund requested | Customer request form | Carlos Rojas (billing) | Awaiting customer signoff | 2026-08-20 | Customer requested partial, they asked for invoice-level note; confirm tax treatment | CONFLUENCE-credits-2026
INV-2026-00990 | BrightEdge AI | dedicated-pool | 12,000.00 | Capacity overrun credit (one-time) | Eng (quota-adjust) | Liam O'Connor (product) | Needs legal review | 2026-08-25 | Contract clause C.7 may limit credit; pull contract copy and escalate to legal | JIRA-INV-4921
INV-2026-01020 | TinyStart Inc. | private-vpc | 75.00 | Test account misc credit | Internal ops | Priya Kapoor (finance) | Completed | 2026-08-14 | Posted to GL 4302; reconcile in August close | GL-4302

AGGREGATE SUMMARY (running totals):
Pending approval total: $16,900.00
Ready for posting: $1,725.00
Completed this sheet: $75.00
Estimated total exposure (all lines): $18,700.00

ACTION ITEMS (owners + quick ask):
- Zoe: confirm GL code mapping for NovaRetail and provide invoice copy by 2026-08-16.
- Priya: post StatelyHealth credit once CS confirms and attach internal memo to batch.
- Carlos: follow up with EduLens finance contact to get signed acceptance and tax form.
- Liam: get contract excerpt and route to Legal (legal@redwood) for BrightEdge review; mark status "legal_review" when submitted.

NOTES TO SELF / OPEN QUESTIONS:
- Do we need to allocate cost center tags for credits coming from Dedicated vs Private? Quick suggestion: tag with billing_project column, finance will map to cost center on posting.
- If a credit is disputed after posting, keep original invoice number + create reversal entry; track reversals in separate tab (recommended).
- For large credits (> $5k) require VP-Finance signoff before posting. Add signoff column if we expand this tracker.

ATTACHMENTS / ARTIFACTS TO COLLECT (per row):
- Signed customer request / approval (pdf)
- Contract excerpt or clause pointer (for > $5k)
- Slack thread link or CS ticket link where request originated

QUICK PROCESS NOTES (working draft):
1) Sales/CS fills row and drops initial doc(s).
2) Finance reviews, assigns GL code, marks "Ready for posting" or requests more info.
3) For engineering-caused credits (quota/overrun), ENG provides incident/context note and proposed mitigation.
4) Legal review if above threshold or contract ambiguity.
5) Finance posts batch weekly (Tuesdays), notifies accounting, update ledger and archive artifacts.

RECENT CHANGES / AUDIT TRAIL (notes):
- 2026-08-12: Created by Priya; seeded with items from CS weekly bucket.
- 2026-08-13: Liam added BrightEdge line after product flagged quota anomaly.
- 2026-08-14: TinyStart completed and posted; GL reference added.
- 2026-08-15: Zoe updated NovaRetail notes after sales sync.

SHORT-TERM RISK FLAG (manual):
- BrightEdge credit is largest exposure and contract language is ambiguous; risk: potential partial denial -> requires reserves if legal advises.

END-OF-SHEET QUICK CHECKLIST (for posting run):
- All rows to be posted have attached approval artifact.
- GL codes present for each posting row.
- Legal-exposed items flagged and have ticket number.
- Communication draft ready to customer for each posted credit.
